subject: Odin Labs: AB plan + quality regression guardrails
messages:
From: Ariel Gomez <ariel@odinlabs.ai>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-06-07T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Quick: AB test windows + observed drop on promptset v3

Hi Soojin,

We started the A/B in prod this morning (v2 -> v3 promptset) and are seeing an unexpected ~8% fall in our top-quality pass rate for long-form summarization (samples attached). Can the Redwood team help us triage and (if needed) pause or fallback while we investigate?

Key asks from our PM:
- Can you confirm the current rollout policy and whether there is an automatic fallback?
- If we pause, how fast can we get back to v2?
- We'd like a short-run triage checklist so we can collect the right traces/inputs for your SREs.

Attaching a small sample set (promptset_v3_samples.csv) and our internal metric snapshot. Happy to hop on a call — we have availability 10:30–12:30 PT today.

Thanks,
Ariel
Head of Product, Odin Labs
Ariel@odinlabs.ai

From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai; dev_patel@redwood.ai; rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-06-07T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Quick: AB test windows + observed drop on promptset v3

Forwarding from Odin (see attachments). They report an 8% drop on long-form summarization after switching to promptset v3.

Short ask to the team:
- Marissa: product asks — prioritize triage and decide fallback criteria (SLO for quality delta, minimal rollback threshold).
- Dev: can you confirm how fast a rollback to v2 would be (both hosted and dedicated paths) and steps to trigger?
- Rishi: can you advise on the eval gating we currently have and whether an immediate canary rollback is supported by our rollout service?
- Tessa: please coordinate a 30-min sync if we need to align execs / CS.

I'll try to reproduce on a small subset now and will share initial notes. Odin is available for a quick call at 10:30 PT.

--
Soojin Lee
Director, Product Ops, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai; dev_patel@redwood.ai
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai; tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-06-07T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Quick: AB test windows + observed drop on promptset v3

Thanks for the flag. Quick proposal to enable a safe, observable rollback and improve our triage:

1) Immediate actions (next 1–2 hours)
- Trigger a canary halt on Odin's rollout (stop ramp from 30% -> 100%). If they are already at 100%, initiate automated fallback to v2 per rollback playbook.
- Ask Odin to freeze new traffic and collect 200 failing examples (they already attached samples; ask for more with the same schema).

2) Acceptance / rollback criteria (proposal)
- Quality SLO: <= 3% relative drop in top-quality pass rate (30-day baseline). If drop > 5% at 30 minutes post-change, auto-fallback.
- Latency/cost checks: if token latency increased >15% or cost-per-response >20% we also trigger review (but keep focus on quality).

3) Data to collect for triage
- 200 fail examples, input prompts, model logits (if available), exact model variant/quantization profile, sequence length distribution, and any client-side postprocessing.
- Timing: ask Odin to upload to the shared doc linked below.

4) Temporary mitigations
- If rollback is not instant for dedicated customers, apply model routing to host v2 for customers on critical paths.

I'll own the acceptance criteria and send Odin a short checklist. Dev — can you confirm the fallback window and whether we need infra to open a manual rollback ticket?

Thanks,
Marissa
Senior Product Manager, Redwood Inference

From: dev_patel@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai; soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai; tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-06-07T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Quick: AB test windows + observed drop on promptset v3

On short notice: rollback paths and timing
- Hosted API: immediate rollback supported — we can pin the routing rule back to v2 within ~3 minutes after a validated request from the PM (we need an email trigger + changelog entry).
- Dedicated (reserved GPU pools): if they are on Dedicated, rollback to a pinned image takes ~20–30 minutes for a full redeploy; we can do per-customer routing to hosted v2 in ~5–10 minutes as a temporary mitigation.
- Canary halt: we can force traffic back to existing canary buckets instantly. Our rollout service supports an "abort and revert" command.

Technical notes for triage:
- Ask for sequence-length histograms — v3 shows regressions for inputs > 1,200 tokens in our initial repro.
- If they have latency traces, send span ids and sample request ids — that'll let us join traces in the console and look for caching/KV issues.

I'll standby on the call. I can implement a temporary per-customer routing rule if needed.

- Dev
Senior Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai; marissa_cole@redwood.ai; dev_patel@redwood.ai; rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: Ariel Gomez <ariel@odinlabs.ai>
Date: 2028-06-09T17:45:00-07:00
Subject: Summary: Odin triage plan and next steps (short)

Wrapping up the sync and next actions after the call today. Short version for execs and CS: 

What we did
- Paused ramp and routed critical customers back to v2 host while we triage.
- Collected 300 examples from Odin and confirmed degradation concentrates on summaries >1,000 tokens.

Decision & immediate criteria
- Per Marissa's acceptance criteria, we are keeping the temporary routing in place. We will auto-fallback if the measured quality gap remains >5% after 60 minutes of monitoring.

Action owners & timeline
- Odin: upload full CSV + any logits to the shared doc (link below) — Ariel (by EOD).
- Dev: implement per-customer routing and provide expected time-to-rollback for Dedicated customers (in progress).
- Rishi + Marissa: run a quick eval harness on the 300 examples by tomorrow 11:00 PT and report back with signal breakdown (semantic mistake types, hallucination, truncation).
- Soojin: coordinate communications to ODIN execs + CS, draft a short incident note (end of day).

Attachments moved to shared drive: ssp://shared/odin/triage/ (link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1xzOdinABPlan)

Thanks everyone — we have the next checkpoint tomorrow 11:00 PT.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Head of Customer Ops, Redwood Inference
